SQL_STMT_U.val:
WITH sales_summary AS ( SELECT s.billing_customer_id AS customer_id, SUM( COALESCE(s.standard_sales_amount, 0) + COALESCE(s.reduced_sales_amount, 0) ) AS total_sales_amount, SUM( COALESCE(s.standard_tax, 0) + COALESCE(s.reduced_tax, 0) ) AS total_tax, SUM( COALESCE(s.total_gross_profit, 0) ) AS total_gross_profit FROM sale AS s WHERE s.sales_date BETWEEN ':1' AND ':2' GROUP BY s.billing_customer_id ), receipt_summary AS ( SELECT r.billing_customer_id AS customer_id, SUM( COALESCE(r.amount, 0) ) AS total_receipt_amount FROM receipt AS r WHERE r.receipt_date BETWEEN ':1' AND ':2' GROUP BY r.billing_customer_id ) SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name,
CASE WHEN c.tax_category = 2 THEN COALESCE(ss.total_sales_amount, 0) ELSE COALESCE(ss.total_sales_amount, 0) + COALESCE(ss.total_tax, 0) END AS total_amount,
COALESCE(ss.total_gross_profit, 0) AS total_gross_profit, COALESCE(rs.total_receipt_amount, 0) AS total_receipt_amount,
DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COALESCE(ss.total_sales_amount, 0) DESC ) AS sales_rank,
SUM( COALESCE(ss.total_sales_amount, 0) ) OVER () AS total_sales_all,
ROUND( COALESCE(ss.total_sales_amount, 0) / NULLIF( SUM(COALESCE(ss.total_sales_amount, 0)) OVER (), 0 ) * 100, 2 ) AS sales_share_percent
FROM customer AS c LEFT JOIN sales_summary AS ss ON ss.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN receipt_summary AS rs ON rs.customer_id = c.id WHERE ss.total_sales_amount IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sales_rank, c.id;
